name: Fast Move Product for POS
description: Boost sales with our Odoo POS app that spotlights your best-selling items.  This app automatically features top sellers on your POS screen, highlighting them for faster customer selection.
summary: This module automatically highlights your best-selling items on the POS screen, displaying them in the first row with customizable colors for quick visibility. Cashiers can easily identify and select top sellers, improving efficiency and enhancing the customer experience. Seamlessly integrates with your existing Odoo POS setup and is simple to configure. The Fast-Moving & Top-Selling Products Highlight App for Odoo POS allows you to configure and showcase your most popular products directly on the POS screen. With this module, selected fast-moving items are automatically displayed on the first row of the product list and can be highlighted with a custom background color for quick identification. This app helps businesses boost sales efficiency by giving instant visibility to their most important products. Instead of scrolling through a long product list, cashiers can quickly identify fast-moving items displayed prominently on the first row of the POS product screen. With this app, you can configure which products are considered fast-moving and set a distinct background color for them, making them stand out visually. This not only saves time for POS operators but also helps in upselling and reducing checkout delays. name: Custom Discounts for Point of Sale
description: Easily apply and manage custom discounts directly in your Odoo POS. This module empowers cashiers and managers to offer flexible price reductions, track discount reasons, and enhance customer satisfaction
summary: The POS Custom Discount app for Odoo is a powerful and user-friendly extension designed to give businesses more flexibility and control over discount management within their Point of Sale operations. Standard POS modules typically provide fixed promotional discounts, but they often lack the ability to create customized offers that meet specific business needs. This app bridges that gap by introducing a Custom Discount feature, allowing POS users to create, apply, and track both predefined and custom discounts directly from the POS interface. With this app, administrators can enable the Custom Discount option from the Odoo backend under the POS settings. Once activated, the POS interface will display a dedicated “Custom Discount” button, alongside any existing discount schemes like seasonal promotions (e.g., “Christmas Offer”) or store milestones (e.g., “Shop 6-Year Completion”). This empowers cashiers or sales staff to either apply predefined discounts to selected order lines or the entire order, or create new custom discounts instantly during checkout. The process is straightforward: after selecting products in the POS cart, the cashier can open the discount dialog to choose from available offers or click on the Custom Discount button to create a new one. The system prompts the user to enter a discount percentage and a reason, ensuring that every custom discount is not only applied correctly but also documented for transparency. Discounts can be applied to individual items (Selected Line) or the entire order (All Line). This ensures maximum flexibility, whether the business wants to promote specific products or reward loyal customers with special order-wide deals. name: POS Complimentary Product
description: This module enhances Point of Sale by enabling automatic addition of complimentary products to orders. It simplifies promotional offers by linking free items with selected products, reducing manual effort at checkout.
summary: The POS Complimentary Products module enhances Odoo’s Point of Sale by automating promotional offers with complimentary (free) items. Instead of relying on cashiers to manually add free products during checkout, the app automatically applies them whenever the defined rules are met. With flexible configuration options, businesses can enable the feature in POS settings and assign complimentary products directly from the product form. Quantity thresholds and offer limits provide greater control, making promotions like “Buy 5, Get 1 Free” simple to manage. Complimentary products are clearly displayed in POS order lines and on printed receipts, ensuring full visibility and transparency for customers. This automation not only improves the customer experience but also saves cashier time, reduces errors, and guarantees consistent application of promotional campaigns. The module is ideal for retailers, supermarkets, and restaurants looking to run Odoo POS promotions such as free products, loyalty offers, or buy-one-get-one deals. By automating promotional items in POS, businesses can boost sales, strengthen customer loyalty, and simplify their marketing efforts.
